structure: Part 1, shared layout, kit, save actions and copy. Read in full at repos/trade-imports-plants-frontend main (634849a1): src/server/app/shared/layout.njk (130 lines: head, title pattern, GOV.UK header, service navigation, phase banner, back link, recoverable-error and stale-action banners, journey strip, content column, footer), kit.js (316 lines: route auth, content surfaces, journey strip statuses, error summary and field error builders, exit/change/run next-target resolution, server-wide and per-set chrome, recoverable save, stale-action redirect, page GET/POST routes, date field), save-actions.njk (the three ending controls and when they show), section-caption.njk, error-summary.njk, error.njk, set-context.js (set mounts, path-to-set resolution, per-request set context, required seams), paths.js (route shapes and prefixed links), copy.js (locale resolution, English only), copy-leaves.js (copy leaf rule), copy.en.js and copy.cy.js (every shared string, with Welsh counterparts carried in each copy claim's note), sets/high-risk-plants/set.js (set id and base), journeys/linear/config.js (templates folder, layout, session cookie names) and routes-high-risk-plants.js (how the set mounts, configures its seams, guards entry and refuses to start incomplete). Covered: the layout and its blocks, every kit helper (the kit has date-field, error-summary and field-error helpers only; radios, summary rows and buttons come straight from GOV.UK macros in each page's own template, which is another part's), the save actions, the caption, error summary and error page templates, every shared copy string in both locales, and the set's id, base path, layout, cookies, mount and entry guard. No language toggle exists in the layout: recorded as a gap.

claims.statement: Every page carries a CSRF token in a meta tag in its head.
Every page loads the service's own stylesheet and its client-side script as an ES module.
The service always renders in English: there is no language toggle in the layout, and every copy lookup resolves 'en' because no locale selection is wired yet.
claims.quote:
Every call site resolves `en` because no locale toggle is wired yet — locale
 * selection (cookie, language toggle) plugs in via the `locale` argument.

claims.statement: The layout has no language toggle for switching between English and Welsh; the partition's cover list expects one, and the layout file is silent on it.
Every Welsh shared string is a machine draft not reviewed by a translator, and must not be shown to users without Welsh Language Standards sign-off.
claims.quote: // MACHINE-DRAFT Welsh — not reviewed by a translator. Do not ship user-facing without Welsh Language Standards sign-off.

claims.statement: English and Welsh copy bundles are kept structure-identical, and an unknown locale falls back to English.

Both locale bundles
 * exist and `copy-parity.test.js` keeps them structure-identical

claims.statement: Every copy string must be non-empty (or a function that builds the string from parameters); an empty or blank copy value is not allowed.
Every journey page route requires a signed-in session.
Each journey page answers GET (show) and POST (submit) at /notifications/{journeyId}/{slug} under the set's mount, for example /high-risk-plants/notifications/{journeyId}/{slug}.
A notification's overview (hub) is at /notifications/{journeyId} under the set's mount.
A new notification is created at /notifications under the set's mount.
The dashboard is the set's base path itself (/high-risk-plants).
The dashboard section counts the dashboard path, the create path and every path beneath /notifications, so every notification page also counts as in the dashboard section.
claims.note: What the dashboard section is used for (navigation highlight, guard) is outside this part.

export const SET_BASE = `/${SET_ID}`

claims.statement: The high-risk plants set renders its pages in the shared layout (shared/layout.njk), with its page templates under high-risk-plants/journeys/linear.
claims.quote:
export const TEMPLATES = 'high-risk-plants/journeys/linear'
export const LAYOUT = 'shared/layout.njk'

claims.statement: The set keeps the notifications a user knows about in a session cookie named highRiskPlantsKnownJourneys.
The set records whether a notification is still in its opening run through the pages in a session cookie named highRiskPlantsOpeningRun.
The set keeps answers that steer the flow but are not saved to the notification in a session cookie named highRiskPlantsFlowOnlyAnswers.
claims.note: That these answers are not saved to the notification is inferred from the name and the flowOnlyKeys passed to the journey flow (routes-high-risk-plants.js:76).

claims.statement: Before any page handler runs, every high-risk plants route passes an entry guard that may redirect the user elsewhere instead of showing the page.
claims.quote:
const target = await withSetContext(SET_ID, () =>
              journeyEntryGuardTarget(request, h)
            )
            return target ? h.redirect(target).takeover() : h.continue
claims.note: Where the guard sends the user is set in flow/entry-guard.js, outside this part.

claims.statement: The set's guards and context apply only to its own routes, so another set mounted on the same server never runs this set's guards.
The service refuses to start if the set leaves any required configuration unset, instead of falling back silently at request time.
At start-up the service checks that the set's obligations are pure and that every obligation has a fulfilment binding, and will not start otherwise.
claims.note: That a failed assertion stops start-up is inferred from the assert naming; the checks live outside this part.

claims.statement: When answers are read back for display, party references that no longer resolve are dropped.
claims.note: Inferred from the function name; its body is in parties/, another part's.

claims.statement: The set mounts the journey flow (sections, task rows, row status, opening run, entry guard, section captions), its obligation set, its records and session persistence and a journey cookie as one plugin named 'high-risk-plants'.
claims.quote:
configureJourneyFlow(SET_ID, {
          sections,
          taskRows,
          rowStatus,
          nextRunTarget,
          flowOnlyKeys: FLOW_ONLY_KEYS,
          entryGuardTarget,
          sectionCaption: sectionCaptionOf,
          layout: LAYOUT
        })

claims.statement: A request path belongs to the set whose mount it falls under, the longest mount winning; paths such as /health and /auth/* belong to no set.
claims.quote:
@returns {string|undefined} the set id, or undefined where the path is
 * outside every mount — `/health`, `/auth/*`, or a genuinely unrouted URL.

claims.statement: An unrouted URL under the set's mount still gets that set's error page chrome, because the set is resolved from the path before routing.
claims.quote:
the shared error page on an unrouted path under a set's mount, and the view
